target_customer: Healthcare providers and clinics that spend staff time on phone calls with insurers and pharmacies
problem: Staff lose hours navigating phone menus and holds to verify insurance, get approvals and update records. Hey Revia uses voice AI to handle those calls.
business_model: B2B software offered as web app, mobile app and API

founders.name: Shaun Wei
founders.background_notes: Worked on self driving cars at Pony.ai.

founders.name: David (Wenbo) Zhu
prior_employers: OpenLoop (after acquisition, senior director of engineering)

technical_complexity.rationale: Handling phone menus, hold times and payer conversations in real time with 2024 voice models was demanding, but built on available speech and language APIs.

defensibility.rationale: HIPAA compliance and payer workflows add friction, but many voice AI vendors targeted the same calls and the models were shared.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: OpenLoop, a telehealth infrastructure company, acquired the company on 2026-06-30 and folded it into its Launchpad platform, with both founders joining as engineering leaders.

market_need_then: The founding story says the founders' daughters' pediatric clinic spent hours on calls with insurers and pharmacies. Insurance and prior authorization calls are a known administrative cost for providers.

branding.domain_note: Used heyrevia.ai; it now redirects to openloophealth.com after the acquisition.

identity.logo: Primary icon with razzmatazz pink accent (#ec0156) per Brandfetch
identity.visual_style: Assistant style with 'Hey' wake word phrasing

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly wake word style name fits a voice product, but no press about the brand was found and it was absorbed into OpenLoop's platform.

outcome_analysis: Hey Revia was a four person voice AI team from Summer 2024 aimed at healthcare phone calls. It was acquired by OpenLoop, announced around 2026-06-30, with undisclosed terms, and both cofounders took engineering leadership roles there while the product moved into OpenLoop's Launchpad platform. Little funding is public beyond the YC deal, so the exit looks like a capital efficient strategic buy that relies on the founders' Google and AI background.
notes: Acquisition confirmed by MobiHealthNews, HLTH, NatLawReview press release and LinkedIn. Funding: only an aggregator figure of 500K pre-seed in 2024-09 from YC (unverified, not recorded as a round). The dated competitor search returned only 2026 pages, so competition is left empty. The brand colour comes from Brandfetch and may reflect OpenLoop's identity after the acquisition.
